variants.title: Bad Back Day
variants.premise: The dockworker is trying to shift a crate of nails off his shoulder and failing.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can you get me onto a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nilsal! Help me with this crate first.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: You take one end. It is full of nails.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There. My back's gone again.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ships? Nobody's sailing you anywhere.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Someone in the dock building with a ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've never been past that door.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Twelve years of hauling crates. Worth it for the pay.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is the pay good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not really, no.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Spice mostly. Furs when the northern lot come in.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't touch the spice. They count it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Send the cart lad over if you see him.

variants.title: Tide Going Out
variants.premise: The dockworker is tallying spice sacks from a bollard, bread in hand, losing count.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a boat out of Varlamore.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tide's going out. So's my lunch break.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Even if a crew wanted you, they can't take you.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Says who, exactly?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The desk inside. The guards just stand about looking smart.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Aldarin run tips well. The spice lot never tip.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Neither will sail you out, mind.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A ledger. Every hull in the harbour's written in it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't go bothering it without a reason.

options.label: Where can I get a drink?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Flaming Arrow. Ask for the sunbeam ale.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is it any good?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You'll thank me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I will. Tide's back in an hour anyway.

variants.title: He Sees It
variants.premise: The dockworker is coiling rope and stops dead when he sees the quiver.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a ship out of the kingdom?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He looks at the quiver on your back and drops the rope.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. You don't see those down here.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I earned it at the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then stop asking dockhands. Go and see the registrar.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Dock building, desk at the back. You'll see the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Everyone here knows. The betting lot talk of nothing else.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Loudest thing in the capital.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They take whoever the ledger says. Get your name in it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then find a crew. The Aldarin lot are decent.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Mind the wet steps on your way in.
